A project file is the editable document. Soundscaper and Framescaper each write their own suffix and open all of them.

Every suffix below holds the same archive: one ZIP with the same manifest and the same `application/vnd.soundscaper.scape+zip` media type. The suffix is only a routing hint. What a file actually is stays decided by its manifest, schema, capability, and digest checks, so renaming a file neither admits one those checks would refuse nor refuses one they accept.

## Project file suffixes

| Suffix | Written by | Opened by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.sscape` | Soundscaper | Every product | — |
| `.fscape` | Framescaper | Every product | — |
| `.liscape` | No shipping product | Every product | Accepted so that no later product can claim it by accident. |
| `.scape` | Nothing | Every product | Written by releases from before each product had its own suffix. Nothing writes it now. |

A project file is not the same as a rendered export. See [Export formats](/reference/generated/formats/) for the audio and video a finished project can produce.

## Label files

Labels are timed text on their own track. These are the interchange formats the editor reads and writes.

| Format | Extension | Import | Export |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Audacity label text | `.txt` | Yes | Yes |
| SubRip (SRT) | `.srt` | Yes | Yes |
| WebVTT | `.vtt` | Yes | Yes |
| Podcast 2.0 chapters (JSON) | `.json` | No | Yes |
